# Deno 2.9.8 runtime notices

Full license texts for the libraries linked or embedded in the Deno 2.9.8 runtime that `deno compile` puts into the shxray binary. The summary table, the method, and the components that are vendored but not linked are in [`THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`](../../THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md). Rust crate notices are in [`deno-2.9.8-crate-notices.md`](deno-2.9.8-crate-notices.md).

Each text below is copied from the file at the linked revision. Copyright lines are the lines in those files. Nothing in this file was written in as a copyright that the source file did not contain.

## rusty_v8 bindings (crate `v8` 150.4.0)

The bindings' own license. It does not cover the V8 engine or the other Chromium components below. The crates.io tarball omits `LICENSE*` (the crate's `exclude` list). This text is from the Git tag.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/denoland/rusty_v8/blob/v150.4.0/LICENSE>

## V8 15.0.245.2

Pinned by rusty_v8 tag `v150.4.0` as submodule commit `ac1e23989121713ca642f6650b34deff7b686896` (`include/v8-version.h`: `V8_MAJOR_VERSION 15`, `V8_MINOR_VERSION 0`, `V8_BUILD_NUMBER 245`, `V8_PATCH_LEVEL 2`). rusty_v8's `BUILD.gn` links `//v8:v8`, `//v8:v8_libbase`, and `//v8:v8_libplatform`.

`LICENSE` is the notice for V8 code that is not an externally maintained library. `LICENSE.v8` is also in that commit, with an older copyright line. Both are copied.

- `LICENSE`: <https://github.com/denoland/v8/blob/ac1e23989121713ca642f6650b34deff7b686896/LICENSE>
- Copyright in `LICENSE`: `Copyright 2014, the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.`

## Strongtalk-derived assembler inside V8

V8's `LICENSE` says the assembler files are based on the Strongtalk assembler, copyrighted by Sun Microsystems Inc. At this commit the Sun notice is still in the sources. The block below is copied from `src/codegen/x64/assembler-x64.h`, including the comment markers. The same `Copyright (c) 1994-2006 Sun Microsystems Inc.` and `All Rights Reserved.` lines begin `src/codegen/assembler.cc` and `src/codegen/ia32/assembler-ia32.cc`. `src/codegen/arm64/assembler-arm64.cc` begins with `Copyright 2013 the V8 project authors` instead. Not every assembler file was opened.

- File: <https://github.com/denoland/v8/blob/ac1e23989121713ca642f6650b34deff7b686896/src/codegen/x64/assembler-x64.h>
- Copyright: `Copyright (c) 1994-2006 Sun Microsystems Inc.`
- Also in that header: `Copyright 2012 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.`

## ICU 77.1

rusty_v8 submodule `third_party/icu` at `ee5f27adc28bd3f15b2c293f726d14d2e336cbd5`. V8 defaults `v8_enable_i18n_support` to true, and rusty_v8 compiles ICU data into the binary (`icu_use_data_file = false`). The official Deno 2.9.8 Linux x86_64 binary contains `icudt77l` and `Copyright (C) 2016 and later: Unicode, Inc. and others.`

Chromium's `README.chromium` in that tree labels the license `MIT`. The `LICENSE` file itself is the Unicode License v3 (`SPDX-License-Identifier: Unicode-3.0`) followed by third-party notices that the file includes (ICU's older IBM notice, dictionary data, double-conversion, nlohmann/json, `aclocal.m4`, and others). The whole file is copied. Some of those notices, in the file's own words, apply to build files such as `aclocal.m4` rather than to the ICU library.

- Upstream: <https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/deps/icu/+/ee5f27adc28bd3f15b2c293f726d14d2e336cbd5/LICENSE>
- Copyright: `Copyright © 2016-2025 Unicode, Inc.`

  ICU uses the public domain data and code derived from Time Zone
Database for its time zone support. The ownership of the TZ database
is explained in BCP 175: Procedure for Maintaining the Time Zone
Database section 7.

## Abseil

rusty_v8 submodule `third_party/abseil-cpp` at `d16e32215c3ab90ba57c2e904a5344d85c7353e4`. V8's `v8_abseil` target is a dependency of the linked `v8` target. The official binary contains paths under `third_party/abseil-cpp/absl/`.

The `LICENSE` file is the Apache License 2.0 text. Its appendix is the unfilled template `Copyright [yyyy] [name of copyright owner]`, so that line is not a copyright notice. The source files whose paths appear in the binary were opened. Their leading copyright lines are:

- `absl/base/internal/sysinfo.cc`: `Copyright 2017 The Abseil Authors.`
- `absl/base/throw_delegate.cc`: `Copyright 2017 The Abseil Authors.`
- `absl/base/internal/low_level_alloc.cc`: `Copyright 2017 The Abseil Authors.`
- `absl/synchronization/mutex.cc`: `Copyright 2017 The Abseil Authors.`
- `absl/container/internal/raw_hash_set.h`: `Copyright 2018 The Abseil Authors.`
- `absl/synchronization/internal/futex_waiter.cc`: `Copyright 2023 The Abseil Authors.`
- `absl/time/internal/get_current_time_posix.inc`: no copyright line in the file.

Other Abseil files were not opened, so this is not a complete year list.

- Upstream: <https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/third_party/abseil-cpp/+/d16e32215c3ab90ba57c2e904a5344d85c7353e4/LICENSE>

## libc++

Submodule `third_party/libc++/src` at `5abc7f839700f0f17338434e1c1c6a8c87c00c11`. Deno enables rusty_v8's `use_custom_libcxx` feature (`deno_core`'s `v8_use_custom_libcxx`, set on the workspace `deno_core` dependency). `build.rs` then passes `use_custom_libcxx=true`. The official Linux binary contains `libc++ Hardening assertion` strings. `use_custom_libunwind` stays false on Linux, macOS, and Windows (`is_fuchsia || is_android` only). The Linux binary's dynamic libraries include `libgcc_s`, not an in-tree libunwind.

The license file is Apache-2.0 with LLVM exceptions, plus the legacy University of Illinois/NCSA license and the MIT license. Both legacy copyrights name `CREDITS.TXT`, which is copied after the license.

- License: <https://chromium.googlesource.com/external/github.com/llvm/llvm-project/libcxx.git/+/5abc7f839700f0f17338434e1c1c6a8c87c00c11/LICENSE.TXT>
- Credits: <https://chromium.googlesource.com/external/github.com/llvm/llvm-project/libcxx.git/+/5abc7f839700f0f17338434e1c1c6a8c87c00c11/CREDITS.TXT>

## libc++abi

Submodule `third_party/libc++abi/src` at `8f11bb1d4438d0239d0dfc1bd9456a9f31629dda`. The official binary contains paths under `third_party/libc++abi/src/src/`. The license text matches libc++ except that the legacy paragraph names libc++abi. `CREDITS.TXT` is a different list, so it is copied separately.

## simdutf

Submodule `third_party/simdutf` at `f7356eed293f8208c40b3c1b344a50bd70971983`. V8's `v8` target depends on `//third_party/simdutf` unconditionally, and Deno also enables rusty_v8's `simdutf` feature. The official binary contains `simdutf::maximal_binary_length_from_base64`. `README.chromium` at this commit says upstream revision `da645ece`, version 7.7.0, license MIT. The text below is the `LICENSE` file at the submodule commit.

## dragonbox

Submodule `third_party/dragonbox/src` at `beeeef91cf6fef89a4d4ba5e95d47ca64ccb3a44`. V8's `v8_base_without_compiler` depends on `//third_party/dragonbox`. The header `include/dragonbox/dragonbox.h` carries the copyright and names the two licenses. The repository at this commit has `LICENSE-Apache2-LLVM` and `LICENSE-Boost` (the header comment still says `LICENSE-Apache`). `LICENSE-Boost` has no copyright line of its own.

## fast_float

Submodule `third_party/fast_float/src` at `05087a303dad9c98768b33c829d398223a649bc6`. V8's `v8_base_without_compiler` depends on `//third_party/fast_float`. The crate offers MIT or Apache-2.0. The MIT file and the Apache file use slightly different copyright lines, so both files are copied.

- MIT: <https://github.com/fastfloat/fast_float/blob/05087a303dad9c98768b33c829d398223a649bc6/LICENSE-MIT>
- Apache-2.0: <https://github.com/fastfloat/fast_float/blob/05087a303dad9c98768b33c829d398223a649bc6/LICENSE-APACHE>
- Copyright in `LICENSE-MIT`: `Copyright (c) 2021 The fast_float authors`
- Copyright in `LICENSE-APACHE`: `Copyright 2021 The fast_float authors`

## Highway (`libhwy`)

Submodule `third_party/highway/src` at `2607d3b5b0113992fe84d3848859eae13b3b52c1`. V8's `v8_base_without_compiler` depends on `//third_party/highway:libhwy`. The `libhwy` source set at this V8 revision lists `abort.cc`, `aligned_allocator.cc`, `per_target.cc`, `print.cc`, `stats.cc`, `targets.cc`, and `timer.cc`. It does not list `hwy/contrib/random/random-inl.h`. The upstream `LICENSE` still says that file is CC0, and the whole `LICENSE` is copied.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/google/highway/blob/2607d3b5b0113992fe84d3848859eae13b3b52c1/LICENSE>
- Copyright: `Copyright (c) The Highway Project Authors. All rights reserved.`

## glibc math subset inside V8

V8's `third_party/glibc` at the same V8 commit. `README.v8` says license LGPL-2.1, upstream revision `4e21c2075193e406a92c0d1cb091a7c804fda4d9`. `v8_use_libm_trig_functions` defaults to `is_clang`. rusty_v8 uses Clang unless `DISABLE_CLANG` is set. The official Deno 2.9.8 Linux x86_64 binary contains `Ubuntu clang version 22.1.8 (++20260714014902+ca7933e47d3a-1~exp1~20260714135019.80)`. The `libm` source set is then a dependency of `v8_libbase`. The binary is stripped, so these objects were not identified by a unique string.

The `LICENSE` file is the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1. Its copyright line is `Copyright (C) 1991, 1999 Free Software Foundation, Inc.` The compiled sources `branred.c`, `branred.h`, `dla.h`, `mydefs.h`, `s_sin.c`, `sincostab.c`, and `usncs.h` each say `Copyright (C) 2001-2022 Free Software Foundation, Inc.` and `IBM Accurate Mathematical Library`. `s_sin.c` also says `written by International Business Machines Corp.` `endian.h` and `trig.h` instead say `Copyright 2022 The Chromium Authors` and `Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style license that can be found in the LICENSE file.` The `LICENSE` file in this directory is the LGPL text, so those two headers do not name a BSD file of their own.

- License: <https://github.com/denoland/v8/blob/ac1e23989121713ca642f6650b34deff7b686896/third_party/glibc/LICENSE>
- README: <https://github.com/denoland/v8/blob/ac1e23989121713ca642f6650b34deff7b686896/third_party/glibc/README.v8>

## zlib-ng 2.1.6 (inside `libz-sys` 1.1.20)

Deno 2.9.8's CLI default features include `__vendored_zlib_ng`, which enables `libz-sys`'s `zlib-ng` feature. That crate vendors zlib-ng under `src/zlib-ng`. `zlib.h.in` in that tree defines `ZLIBNG_VERSION` as `2.1.6` and `ZLIB_VERSION` as `1.3.0.zlib-ng`. The official binary contains `1.3.0.zlib-ng`. The Rust wrapper's MIT and Apache-2.0 files are in the crate notices. They do not include the copyright below. This `LICENSE.md` is the notice for the vendored C sources.

- Upstream: <https://docs.rs/crate/libz-sys/1.1.20/source/src/zlib-ng/LICENSE.md>
- Copyright: `(C) 1995-2013 Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler`

## TypeScript 6.0.3

Deno 2.9.8's `cli/lib/version.rs` sets `TYPESCRIPT` to `6.0.3`. `cli/tsc/00_typescript.js` begins with `var version = "6.0.3"` and is compiled into the runtime (`cli/tsc/mod.rs` includes it). ## `@types/node` 24.2.0

`tools/update_types_node.ts` at Deno v2.9.8 sets `typesNodeVersion` to `24.2.0`. `cli/build.rs` embeds every `.ts` and `.cts` file under `cli/tsc/dts/node/` into the runtime. The `LICENSE` file in that directory is byte-for-byte the `LICENSE` from the published npm package `@types/node@24.2.0`.
